subject: maths
topic: Simple interest, compound interest and depreciation

kept.q: Adaeze borrowed ₦15,000 from a cooperative society at a simple interest rate of 8% per annum. Find the interest she will pay after 3 years.
kept.pidgin: Simple Interest na (P x R x T)/100. If you put the numbers, (15000 x 8 x 3)/100 give you ₦3,600.

kept.q: Chinwe invested ₦20,000 in a bank that pays compound interest at 10% per annum. Find the total amount in her account after 2 years.
kept.explanation: For compound interest, Amount = P(1 + R/100)^T = 20000(1.1)^2 = 20000 x 1.21 = ₦24,200. This is different from simple interest which would give only ₦24,000.
kept.pidgin: For compound interest, Amount = P(1 + R/100)^T = 20000(1.1)^2 = 20000 x 1.21 = ₦24,200. E dey different from simple interest wey go just give ₦24,000.

kept.q: A commercial bus bought for ₦800,000 depreciates at a rate of 15% per annum on its value at the start of each year. Find the value of the bus after 2 years.
kept.explanation: After year 1: 800000 x 0.85 = ₦680,000. After year 2: 680,000 x 0.85 = ₦578,000. Depreciation is applied each year on the reduced value, not the original cost.
kept.pidgin: After year 1: 800000 x 0.85 = ₦680,000. After year 2: 680,000 x 0.85 = ₦578,000. Depreciation dey apply every year on the new value, no be the original cost.

kept.q: Bello borrowed a sum of money at simple interest for 2 years 6 months. If the interest paid was ₦7,875 and the principal was ₦45,000, find the rate of interest per annum.
A trader invested ₦10,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum. Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on this investment over the period.
kept.pidgin: Simple Interest = (10000 x 10 x 2)/100 = ₦2,000. Compound Interest = 10000(1.1)^2 - 10000 = ₦2,100. The difference be 2100 - 2000 = ₦100.

q.q: Musa deposited ₦12,000 in a bank that pays simple interest at 5% per annum. What amount will be in his account after 4 years?
q.explanation: Interest = (12000 x 5 x 4)/100 = ₦2,400. Amount = Principal + Interest = 12000 + 2400 = ₦14,400.
q.pidgin: Interest = (12000 x 5 x 4)/100 = ₦2,400. Total wey go dey him account na Principal plus Interest, wey be 12000 + 2400 = ₦14,400.
